verdict.rationale: Mastra Code is a terminal-based AI coding agent, so git workflow automation is a fair axis to judge it on. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions staging changes, writing commit messages, creating branches, or opening pull requests. The documented tools cover AST editing, LSP diagnostics, directory access and web search, none of which is git or PR functionality.

support.subject: As a developer, I can have the agent stage changes, write commit messages, create branches, and open pull requests
